name: assaying relational discord
from: An existing authorized Science allocation names a suspected mismatch, relevant mathematical or empirical law, affected carriers and receiving office.
to: A reproducible comparison identifies which differences violate which specified invariants, preserves unproved/unknown/contested evidence, distinguishes root causes from correlated symptoms and yields a falsifiable Engineering specification or exact scientific obstruction.
cost: Bounded source recovery, measurement, proof checking, negative tests and causal investigation; no unapproved infrastructure or financial commitments.
otherwise: Leave the original work open with the missing law, witness, tolerance or authority. Never describe lawful variation or unobserved production state as failed conformity.
receiver-condition: The Chief Science Officer or delegated independent Science receiver checks the claimed law and evidence against the allocation. Engineering may consume the result only as a specification; its patch and Operations' installed receiving are separate states.

x-provenance.source: Leader Tunesday directive, after Mathy Monday, to derive and act upon real ecosystem discord.
